summary: Iter 281 / Phase 2 Org Chart Builder — full backend + frontend verification. Backend deterministic pytest (iter280 + iter281_phase2) PASS. Backend LIVE AI pytest (iter281_orgchart_ai) PASS — all 3 endpoints (ai/generate, ai/analyze, ai/draft-jd) call Claude via Emergent LLM key and return correctly-shaped data (Tom→Sarah reporting inferred, receptionist=vacancy='yes', analyze returns summary/issues[5]/suggestions[5], JD returns 8 responsibilities / 8 requirements). AI tab end-to-end works in UI: text→generate produces preview rows w/ Add-N-cards-to-chart apply button; analyze renders structured issues+suggestions in orgchart-ai-analysis; JD draft renders in orgchart-jd-result with Copy button. Settings groupby selector works. Regression: List view, export csv/png/pdf + import dropzone all intact (14 list rows after additions). ui_bugs.issue: After setting Settings → Group by = Department, cards correctly receive department-colored left borders, but I could not detect any coloured-dashed rectangular group FRAMES behind the cards via DOM queries (svg rect[stroke-dasharray], div[style*='dashed'], [data-group-frame] all returned 0). Visual screenshot also does not show frame rectangles. May be a rendering gap (frames depend on layout pass or have a different DOM signature). Worth a manual look — if frames are supposed to be visible behind cards, they currently are not (only per-card colored borders).

issues: Cookie consent banner overlays bottom of viewport on first visit (still). Dismissing 'Accept All' works for the session — same minor note as iter280.
